measure_name: Investing in and connecting public institutions
definition: The project builds, rehabilitates, upgrades, equips, connects, establishes or delivers a programme through identified public institutions, service facilities or member organisations. These include schools, universities, health facilities, government offices, local governments, disaster management and meteorological agencies, agricultural extension offices, and farmer organisations or cooperatives. Upgrades include connecting the institution to broadband or internet, a government or sector network, or electricity. The sentence must name the kind of institution and what the project does at or through it. Excludes policy or sector reform with no named institution, support to households or firms in general, and backbone networks with no named institutions.
